title: ICAB P3 - Business Planning: Taxation & Compliance
summary: Advanced corporate taxation, group relief, business restructuring, international taxation, transfer pricing, dispute resolution, tax litigation, and strategic VAT compliance under Bangladesh tax legislation.

all.name: Full Syllabus Tracker
all.blurb: Official 2025 Syllabus chapter and topic tracker for Business Planning: Taxation & Compliance. Track your study progress across all syllabus areas.

stages.title: Area 1: Income Tax Administration, Disputes & Transfer Pricing
stages.name: Area 1: Income Tax Administration, Disputes & Transfer Pricing
stages.description: Tax assessments, audit, appeals to Appellate Tribunal and High Court, ADR, and Transfer Pricing Chapter.

nodes.name: Tax Litigation, Appeals & Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR)
nodes.description: Selection of cases for tax audit; assessment under Section 180 vs best judgment under Section 182; appeals to Commissioner (Appeals); Taxes Appellate Tribunal; High Court references; Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) mechanism.
topics: Audit selection criteria and powers of Deputy Commissioner of Taxes (DCT)
Reopening of assessment: Section 212 powers and statutory time bars
First appeal to Commissioner of Taxes (Appeals): Grounds, deposit requirements, timelines
Second appeal to Taxes Appellate Tribunal: Composition, procedures, legal questions
Reference applications to High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh
Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR): Eligibility, facilitator role, binding agreement
learningOutcomes: Formulate grounds of appeal for disputed tax assessments.
Advise clients on ADR benefits and dispute resolution strategy.
Draft legal submissions for Taxes Appellate Tribunal.
checklists: Review appellate timeline and mandatory tax deposit rules
Study ADR procedural guidelines under ITA 2023
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

nodes.name: Transfer Pricing, International Tax & Double Taxation
nodes.description: Arm's length principle; Transfer Pricing methods under ITA 2023 (CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split); TP documentation and accountant certification; Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAA); permanent establishment (PE).
topics: Transfer pricing regulations under Bangladesh Income Tax Act 2023
Definition of associated enterprise and international transactions
Arm's length price determination methods: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, Profit Split, TNMM
Transfer pricing documentation requirements and mandatory Chartered Accountant certificate
Double Tax Avoidance Agreements (DTAA): Credit method vs Exemption method
Permanent Establishment (PE) concepts and taxation of cross-border digital services
learningOutcomes: Select and defend the most appropriate transfer pricing method.
Compute tax credits under DTAA provisions.
Identify Permanent Establishment exposure for multinational entities.
checklists: Read Transfer Pricing, International Tax & Double Taxation in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 2: Corporate Tax Planning & Restructuring
stages.name: Area 2: Corporate Tax Planning & Restructuring
stages.description: Tax planning for corporate reorganizations, mergers, amalgamations, demergers, and incentives.

nodes.name: Tax-Efficient Mergers, Acquisitions & Incentives
nodes.description: Tax implications of business combinations, amalgamations, and demergers; carry-forward and set-off of accumulated losses; tax holidays and economic zone incentives (BEZA, BIDA, Hi-Tech parks); tax-efficient financing structures (debt vs equity, thin capitalization).
topics: Tax treatment of amalgamations and company mergers under ITA 2023
Conditions for transfer of accumulated tax losses and unabsorbed depreciation in mergers
Demergers, slump sales, and asset acquisitions tax implications
Tax holiday regimes for industrial undertakings, physical infrastructure, and green initiatives
Incentives in Special Economic Zones (BEZA) and Hi-Tech Parks
Tax planning for employee remuneration: ESOPs, provident funds, gratuity approvals
Thin capitalization and interest deductibility restrictions
learningOutcomes: Advise corporations on claiming tax holiday benefits in Economic Zones.
Optimize debt-equity ratios considering tax deductibility.
checklists: Read Tax-Efficient Mergers, Acquisitions & Incentives in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 3: Strategic VAT Compliance & Customs
stages.name: Area 3: Strategic VAT Compliance & Customs
stages.description: VAT planning, audits, investigations, appeals, customs valuation, and import-export procedures.

nodes.name: VAT Audits, Investigations, Appeals & Customs
nodes.description: VAT audits and investigations by Customs, Excise and VAT Commissionerate; demand notices and show-cause proceedings; appeals to Commissioner (Appeals) and Customs, Excise and VAT Appellate Tribunal; customs valuation under Customs Act 2023; bonded warehouse facilities.
topics: Powers of VAT officers during audits, inspections, and seizure of records
Adjudication process: Show Cause Notice (SCN) response and personal hearings
VAT appellate procedure: Appeal to Commissioner (Appeals), Tribunal, and High Court
Input tax rebate disputes, credit cancellation, and recovery of unpaid VAT
Customs Act 2023: Assessment of customs duty, regulatory duty, and advance tax on imports
Customs valuation methods: Transaction value of imported goods and adjustments
Bonded warehouse facilities, duty drawback, and export facilitation
learningOutcomes: Draft replies to VAT show-cause notices.
Navigate the VAT and Customs appellate ladder.
Optimize customs duty through bonded warehouse and drawback facilities.
checklists: Read VAT Audits, Investigations, Appeals & Customs in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)
